Only result files of the final code of a reviewed step belong here. Desktop runtime files carry their Obsidian and Electron versions; device reports carry the device's environment. BLOCKED targets say why (research/14 §6.23). Step 11H after C3 (research/14 §6.144): the runs are the final results of the current theme code (src and scripts unchanged since d388397), judged against the Inkdrop 6.2.0 rendered reference.
